description: Bulk-update selected product records with a single patch (status, set/adjust stock, set/adjust price). Stock is whole units; price is major units - the stored price field value, not cents - and changes the default-currency price only; prices in additional currencies are left as they are.

modelId.description: The product model's id or slug (from list_models)

patch.description: Single patch applied to every selected record

adjustPrice.description: Delta to price (major units of the default currency, +/-)

setPrice.description: Set absolute price (major units of the default currency - the stored price field value, 49.99 = $49.99)

allMatching.description: Target every record matching filter (ignores ids)

priceMax.description: Major units - filters the stored price field directly

priceMin.description: Major units - filters the stored price field directly

name: bulk_update_products
title: Bulk update products
